summary: The filing is an 8-K by SIM Acquisition Corp. I, a blank-check company, postponing its extraordinary general meeting from April 23, 2026 to May 1, 2026 to vote on an extension of its business combination deadline from July 11, 2026 to July 12, 2027. The redemption deadline is extended to April 29, 2026. No deal terms are disclosed. This is a routine procedural filing to facilitate a charter extension vote, not a special situation.
